title: The Carnegie-Irvine Galaxy Survey. IX. Classification of bulge types and statistical properties of pseudo bulges

evidence.locator: Appendix A and Table 2 (Best-fit Parameters of the CGS Ellipticals; CDS J/ApJS/247/20/table2), row NGC 4696: single-Sérsic R-band fit, mean effective surface brightness 20.72 +/- 0.12 mag per square arcsec, n = 2.99 +/- 0.13, effective radius 16.65 +/- 1.46 kpc, ellipticity 0.219. The table gives no position angle. The appendix warns that a single Sérsic function integrates to infinity and that ellipticals are better fitted by several components.
